mapper.sql: term_condition_applies.id AS id, term_condition_applies.module_type_id AS moduleTypeId, module_types.name AS moduleTypeName, term_condition_applies.term_condition_type_id AS termConditionTypeId, term_condition_types.name AS termConditionTypeName, term_condition_applies.term_condition_default_id AS termConditionDefaultId, term_conditions.name AS termConditionDefaultName

FROM term_condition_applies INNER JOIN module_types ON module_types.id = term_condition_applies.module_type_id INNER JOIN term_condition_types ON term_condition_types.id = term_condition_applies.term_condition_type_id LEFT JOIN term_conditions ON term_conditions.id = term_condition_applies.term_condition_default_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO term_condition_applies ( module_type_id, term_condition_type_id, term_condition_default_id, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{termConditionApply.moduleTypeId}, #{termConditionApply.termConditionTypeId}, #{termConditionApply.termConditionId}, NOW(), #{termConditionApply.createdBy}, #{termConditionApply.isActive} )
mapper.update: UPDATE term_condition_applies SET module_type_id = #{termConditionApply.moduleTypeId}, term_condition_type_id = #{termConditionApply.termConditionTypeId}, term_condition_default_id = #{termConditionApply.termConditionId}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{termConditionApply.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{termConditionApply.id} AND is_active = 1
UPDATE term_condition_applies SET is_active = 2, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{userId} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_active = 1
